name: GymAI News
summary: News site for the GymAI training app: training-science explainers plus dev logs from building the product.
description: A WordPress news site for GymAI, a training app in development. Posts are organised into training science, injury & rehab, gyms & chains, professionals, privacy & data, product and a running dev log — the dev-log entries recount the app's commits, design rounds, security audits and features as they ship. Reading is free; the app itself is pre-launch with a waiting list.
